b.eef7f0b822:
<h>Martyrologium</h>
<c>P</c>rídie Kaléndas Augústi Luna vicésima séptima. Anno Dómini 2027
<h>R</h>omæ natális sancti Ignátii, Presbýteri et Confessóris, qui Fundátor éxstitit Societátis Jesu, atque vir fuit sanctitáte et miráculis clarus, ac religiónis cathólicæ ubíque dilatándæ studiosíssimus; quem Pius Undécimus, Póntifex Máximus, cæléstem ómnium Exercitiórum spirituálium Patrónum constítuit.
<h>M</h>edioláni sancti Calimérii, Epíscopi et Mártyris; qui, in Antoníni persecutióne, comprehénsus, vulnéribus confóssus, cervicibúsque gládio transverberátis, præceps in púteum deiéctus, martýrii cursum confécit.
<h>C</h>æsaréæ, in Mauritánia, pássio beáti Fábii Mártyris, qui, cum ferre vexílla præsidália recusáret, primo in cárcerem trusus est, ibíque diébus áliquot deténtus; deínde, cum in confessióne Christi, interrogátus semel et íterum, immóbilis perduráret, senténtia capitáli a Júdice condemnátur.
<h>S</h>ýnnadæ, in Phrýgia Pacatiána, sanctórum Mártyrum Demócriti, Secúndi et Dionýsii.
<h>I</h>n Sýria sanctórum trecentórum quinquagínta Monachórum Mártyrum, qui, ob defensiónem Sýnodi Chalcedonénsis, ab hæréticis sunt occísi.
<h>R</h>avénnæ tránsitus sancti Germáni, Antisiodorénsis Epíscopi, génere, fide, doctrína et miraculórum glória claríssimi; qui Británniam a Pelagianórum hærésibus pénitus liberávit.
<h>T</h>agáste, in Africa, sancti Firmi Epíscopi, confessiónis glória conspícui.
<h>S</h>enis, in Túscia, natális beáti Joánnis Columbíni, qui fuit Institútor Ordinis Iesuatórum, et sanctitáte ac miráculis cláruit.
<r>℣.</r> Et álibi aliórum plurimórum sanctórum Mártyrum et Confessórum, atque sanctárum Vírginum.
<r>℟.</r> Deo grátias.
b.ac848a4d25:
<h>Martyrology</h>
<c>J</c>uly 31st 2027, the 27th day of the Moon, was born into the better life:
<h>A</h>t Rome, the birthday of St. Ignatius, confessor, founder of the Society of Jesus, renowned for sanctity and miracles, and most zealous for propagating the Catholic religion in all parts of the world.
<h>A</h>t Milan, during the persecution of Antoninus, St. Calimerius, bishop and martyr, who was arrested, covered with wounds, and pierced through the neck with a sword. He terminated his martyrdom by being precipitated into a well.
<h>A</h>t Caesarea, in Mauretania, the martyrdom of the blessed martyr Fabius. As he refused to carry the ensign of the governor of the province, he was thrown into prison for some days, and as he persisted twice in confessing Christ when brought before the judge, he was condemned to capital punishment.
<h>A</h>t Synnada, in Phrygia, the holy martyrs Democritus, Secundus and Denis.
<h>I</h>n Syria, three hundred and fifty monks, who became martyrs by being slain by the heretics for defending the Council of Chalcedon.
<h>A</h>t Ravenna, the departure from this world of St. Germanus, bishop of Auxerre, a man most renowned for his birth, faith, learning, and glorious miracles, who freed England completely from the heretical doctrines of the Pelagians.
<h>A</h>t Tagaste, in Africa, St. Firmus, bishop, illustrious by a glorious confession of the faith.
<h>A</h>t Siena, in Tuscany, the birthday of blessed John Colombini, founder of the Order of the Jesuati, renowned for sanctity and miracles.
<r>℣.</r> And elsewhere many other holy martyrs, confessors, and holy virgins.
<r>℟.</r> Thanks be to God.

b.949f424f66:
<h>Oratio</h>
<c>K</c>ýrie, eléison. Christe, eléison. Kýrie, eléison.
<n><k>Pater Noster</k> dicitur secreto usque ad <k>Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:</k></n>
<c>P</c>ater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum: advéniat regnum tuum: fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum cotidiánum da nobis hódie: et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris:
<r>℣.</r> Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:
<r>℟.</r> Sed líbera nos a malo.

<r>℣.</r> Dóminus vobíscum.
<r>℟.</r> Et cum spíritu tuo.
<c>O</c>rémus.
<c>D</c>eus, qui omnipoténtiam tuam parcéndo máxime et miserándo maniféstas: multíplica super nos misericórdiam tuam; ut, ad tua promíssa curréntes, cæléstium bonórum fácias esse consórtes.
<h>P</h>er Dóminum nostrum Jesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
<r>℟.</r> Amen.
b.bfce3e04bc:
<h>Prayer</h>
<c>L</c>ord have mercy upon us, Christ have mercy upon us, Lord have mercy upon us.
<n><k>Our Father</k> is said silently until <k>And lead us not into temptation:</k>.</n>
<c>O</c>ur Father, who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us.
<r>℣.</r> And lead us not into temptation:
<r>℟.</r> But deliver us from evil.

<r>℣.</r> The Lord be with you.
<r>℟.</r> And with thy spirit.
<c>L</c>et us pray.
<c>O</c> God, Who declarest thine Almighty power most chiefly in showing mercy and pity, mercifully grant unto us such a measure of thy grace, that we, running the way of thy commandments, may obtain thy gracious promises, and be made partakers of thy heavenly treasure.
<h>T</h>hrough Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
<r>℟.</r> Amen.

<r>Commemoratio B. Mannis Confessoris O. P.</r>
<r>Ant.</r> Euge, serve bone et fidélis, quia in pauca fuísti fidélis, supra multa te constítuam, dicit Dóminus.

<r>℣.</r> Justus germinábit sicut lílium.
<r>℟.</r> Et florébit in ætérnum ante Dóminum.

<c>O</c>rémus.
<c>D</c>eus, qui beátum Mannem Confessórem tuum dispositiône mirábili in viam perfectiόνis traduxísti; eádem misericórdiæ grátia dirige actus nostros: ut possimus quærere quod jubes, et assequi quod promíttis.

<r>Commemoratio S. Abdon et Sennen Martyrum</r>
<r>Ant.</r> Isti sunt Sancti, qui pro Dei amóre minas hóminum contempsérunt: sancti Mártyres in regno cælórum exsúltant cum Angelis. O quam pretiósa est mors Sanctórum, qui assídue assístunt ante Dóminum, et ab ínvicem non sunt separáti!

<r>℣.</r> Mirábilis Deus.
<r>℟.</r> In sanctis suis.

<c>O</c>rémus.
<c>D</c>eus, qui sanctis tuis Abdon et Sennen ad hanc glóriam veniéndi copiósum munus grátiæ contulísti: da fámulis tuis suórum véniam peccatórum; ut, Sanctórum tuórum intercedéntibus méritis, ab ómnibus mereántur adversitátibus liberári.
<h>P</h>er Dóminum nostrum Jesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
<r>℟.</r> Amen.

<r>Commemoration of B. Mannis Confessoris O. P.</r>
<r>Ant.</r> Well done, thou good and faithful servant thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things, saith the Lord.

<r>℣.</r> The just shall spring as the lily.
<r>℟.</r> And shall flourish for ever before the Lord.

<c>L</c>et us pray.
<c>O</c> God, who by a wonderful disposition didst lead blessed Mannes thy Confessor into the way of perfection: by the same grace of thy mercy direct our actions, that we may seek what thou commandest and attain what thou promisest.

<r>Commemoration of St. Abdon and Sennen, Martyr</r>
<r>Ant.</r> These are the holy ones who for the love of Christ, recked nothing of the threats of men. In the kingdom of heaven the holy martyrs are filled with joy in the company of Angels. O how precious in the sight of the Lord was the death of these His saints who now stand day and night in His presence and are not divided the one from the other.

<r>℣.</r> Mirábilis Deus.
<r>℟.</r> In sanctis suis.

<c>L</c>et us pray.
<c>O</c> God, Who didst give unto thy saints Abdon and Sennen the abundant grace whereby to attain unto this glory, Grant unto thy servants the remission of all their sins, that, with the pleading of the worthy deeds of thy Saints, they may worthily be delivered from all things hurtful.
<h>T</h>hrough Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
<r>℟.</r> Amen.
